text: The Scarborough Walk of Fame is a non-profit, volunteer organization dedicated to, "honouring individuals who bring pride to the community of Scarborough and serve to inspire tomorrow's leaders." This local landmark, located in the Scarborough Town Centre, recognizes an array of past and present Scarborough residents, including those who have reached exceptional achievement in the arts, sports, sciences, humanities, health, and education. I am asking that the following motion be placed on the May 27th, 2022, Scarborough Community Council agenda and that members of the SCC receive this presentation for information.
Scarborough Community Council: 1. Extended an invitation to Scarborough Walk of Fame Chair, Marg Middleton, to present at the May 27 2022 meeting, as the first item of business.
